scope: Parsed complete selected-locus records only; no filesystem, BAM, pipeline, network, CLI or inference. Input arrays are list/tuple, rows are dict. No cell-by-gene Cartesian expansion.

count_row_required.peak_name: nonblank native string; unique mapping within sample

catalogue_row_required.gene_id: native nonblank string, or null/blank for explicitly unassigned (normal audit exclusion)
catalogue_row_required.strand: +/- when gene assigned; null/blank/dot permitted for unassigned
catalogue_row_required.feature: native nonblank context string; no context reassignment
catalogue_row_required.misprimed_ratio: finite numeric [0,1] or null for not evaluable
catalogue_row_required.general_mispriming_pass: JSON boolean, agrees with ratio<=recorded general threshold
catalogue_row_required.intronic_mispriming_pass: JSON boolean, agrees with ratio<=recorded intronic threshold
catalogue_row_required.mispriming_pass: JSON boolean; intronic flag for Intron, general flag otherwise
catalogue_row_required.is_distal_peak: JSON boolean or null; used without selecting a new distal
catalogue_row_required.distance_to_stop_codon: native numeric distance or null; Python NaN/Inf allowed as unavailable-order input, never emitted
catalogue_row_required.n_peaks_in_gene: positive integer for eligible terminal sites, otherwise null or positive integer
catalogue_row_required.peak_order_in_gene: positive integer for eligible terminal sites, otherwise null or positive integer

identity: sample_id + cell_barcode + gene_id + strand; gene_name never used for identity. Strings such as NA, 001, 1 stay distinct; text values are not trimmed or converted. Maximum identifier length512.
unit_registry: null or list of explicit sample_id/cell_barcode/gene_id/strand requests for known catalogue genes, including zero-count units; union with observed assigned count units. Duplicate requests fail. Unassigned-only counts create no gene unit.

policy_required.sample_ids: unique nonempty list of <=1000 explicit sample IDs

policy_optional_limits.rule: Only reductions to positive integers accepted. Output records =5/unit +1/catalogue site +1/sample audit. Integer sums bounded by9007199254740991. All caps reject with structured limit_exceeded; no partial return or silent truncation. Callers may batch selected loci/units explicitly in a separate layer.

provenance: Caller-supplied dict of <=32 scalar JSON entries, <=65536 encoded bytes; string values<=4096. May contain run_commit:null or an unverified claimed commit/hash/path. Output explicitly labels trust=caller_supplied_not_certified. Completeness, external sample identity, external file hashes and producer completion are NOT verified. Reviewed product commit is never inserted as run version.

native_sets.T: count sum over native general-pass Terminal_exon or Downstream_of_terminal_exon with assigned gene; includes single-terminal genes
native_sets.I: count sum over native intronic-pass Intron with assigned gene
native_sets.D: count at exactly one native flagged terminal distal whose finite distance is unique maximum. Ties, absent/incorrect flag or nonfinite distance make D unavailable, never select a substitute
native_sets.S_assigned_raw: all assigned counts for that gene/strand, including evaluable failed intronic audit sites and other contexts
native_sets.S_retained: all assigned counts with native mispriming_pass=true across all contexts
native_sets.failed_intronic_audit_umis: count sum over intronic sites not passing native intronic filter

metrics.distal_fraction_terminal_conditional: D/T; for >=2 eligible sites value_or_null follows psi_min_gene_umis mask; raw_arithmetic_value_or_null separately preserves arithmetic. Single-terminal value is a control and recipe_native_comparable_distal_value_or_null=null.

semantics: Four named metrics always emitted per unit; no implicit S choice and no overwrite/relabel of native outputs.
Zero numerator with positive denominator is0; zero denominator is null. No pseudocounts. Missing/incomplete input declarations are validation errors, never zeros.
Missing sparse site rows are zero only under caller's explicit complete scope for observed or requested known units.
No eligible terminal site: D-related and intronic comparative ratios unavailable; preserve S,I,T counts. Single terminal: D/T arithmetic control, not switching evidence.

No intronic candidate: I fraction may be0 with explicit no_intronic_candidate_not_absence_of_biology note. Existing but all failed/not-evaluable intronic candidates: fraction unavailable/no_retained_intronic_evidence.
Failed intronic counts contribute only to raw S and audit totals; NA-ratio or failed-nonintronic positive counts are inconsistent with reviewed native count population and rejected.
Metadata pass flags are validated for consistency with recorded thresholds, never repaired/replaced. Terminal count/order membership must agree with complete supplied catalogue.
Same maximal distance or multiple distal flags disables only distal metrics; intronic arithmetic remains independent. Minus strand uses native distance/flags, not maximum genome coordinate.
Explicit unassigned catalogue records are normal audit exclusions; unknown count peak is validation_error. Duplicate final count rows or catalogue peaks rejected, not summed or chosen-first.
Stable output sorting; no NaN output; caller input is unchanged. Other locus/evidence annotations may be provided but are not interpreted or certified.
No switching_eligible or native_psi_eligible field. This recipe makes no comparative switching inference. Literal structural and per-unit arithmetic facts are separated in denominator rows.
failure: DiagnosticValidationError(ValueError), with code/detail and as_dict(); no partial output. Return status in individual metrics for valid-but-unavailable ratios.
limitations: No authentication of provenance or proof that caller's catalogue covers a whole locus; structural checks do not replace external producer validation.
No file adapters, gene/transcript reassignment, re-deduplication, locus plot, group pooling, significance test, mechanistic interpretation or evidence of real-data validation.
This recipe supports terminal-aware complete parsed inputs only. Legacy summaries or terminal-only PSI cannot supply S.

Results now use schema v2 because ambiguous booleans/native-comparable field names were removed or renamed. Defaults are intentionally small; callers must handle limit_exceeded with explicit batching, not raise caps.

byte_budget_contract.output_encoding: Exactly json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=True,sort_keys=True,separators=(",",":"),allow_nan=False).encode("utf-8"). No indent or trailing newline. Alternative pretty serialization can be larger and is outside this canonical byte cap.
byte_budget_contract.output_accounting: Complete initial empty-list result envelope is streamed with JSONEncoder.iterencode, including schema, interpretation, scope/limits, sample IDs and caller-supplied provenance. Each bounded denominator/metric/site-audit/sample-audit record is encoded and charged together with its array comma before append. The entire growing/final result is never serialized to check its size. Records exceeding remaining capacity are not retained; exception returns no partial result.
byte_budget_contract.input_accounting: Before building normalized catalogue/count mappings or copying provenance into result, traverse the named argument envelope {count_rows,catalogue_rows,unit_registry,policy,provenance}. Aggregate lengths of all keys and string values after ensure_ascii=True JSON escaping, excluding their surrounding quotes; count every occurrence, even repeated references and unused fields. Strings are checked and encoded in <=4096-codepoint chunks, never by serializing the whole input. Number/boolean/null characters and structural punctuation are not input TEXT bytes; nodes bound traversal separately.
byte_budget_contract.input_structure: Every container, scalar value and object key visited counts as a node; named argument envelope is depth0, maximum depth8 (fixed, not raisable). Object keys must be strings. Supported parsed values: dict,list,tuple,str,int,float,bool,null. Cyclic/deep input fails at depth cap; no deep copy or unbounded traversal.
byte_budget_contract.scope: Default result<=1MiB canonical JSON, aggregate escaped input text<=4MiB. This is a serialization/recipe bound, not proof that a downstream model has enough context or that raw caller input allocation was bounded.

denominator_row_fields.S_assigned_raw: All counts assigned to this gene+strand including failed intronic audit sites
denominator_row_fields.S_retained: Assigned counts passing native context-aware filters
denominator_row_fields.T: Eligible terminal count sum, possibly zero
denominator_row_fields.I: Retained intronic count sum, possibly zero
denominator_row_fields.D: Unique native distal-site count, or null when distal metadata unavailable
denominator_row_fields.eligible_terminal_site_count: Number of native general-pass terminal catalogue sites
denominator_row_fields.retained_intronic_site_count: Number of native intronic-pass catalogue sites
denominator_row_fields.unique_distal_peak_name: Unique validated native distal peak ID or null
denominator_row_fields.has_multiple_eligible_terminal_sites: Structural catalogue fact: eligible_terminal_site_count>=2. Does not imply positive counts or available value.
denominator_row_fields.has_unique_distal_metadata: Structural fact: one supplied native distal flag agrees with unique finite maximal terminal distance; false for no terminal, ties, missing/nonfinite or inconsistent distal metadata.
denominator_row_fields.terminal_depth_passes_native_mask: Per-unit arithmetic fact T>=recorded psi_min_gene_umis. Can be true at T=0 if threshold0; positive denominator is an independent requirement.
denominator_row_fields.recipe_native_comparable_distal_value_av: True iff the preceding four booleans are all true. Says only this recipe can compute a native-definition-comparable distal fraction for this unit; does NOT assert native output contains a row, certify provenance or imply comparative switching evidence.

terminal_metric_extra_semantics.raw_arithmetic_value_or_null: D/T when unique D exists and T>0, before native depth masking; includes explicitly labelled single-terminal controls.
terminal_metric_extra_semantics.recipe_native_comparable_distal_value_or: D/T only when denominator-row recipe_native_comparable_distal_value_available=true; null otherwise. Recipe-computed value, NOT an authenticated or inspected native export.
